_comment: Example taskfile for workflow-kit/scripts/dispatch.sh. 'executor' picks the runner so PARALLEL tasks diversify across opencode/kilo/hermes (a rate-limited provider on one runner never blocks the batch). 'model' optionally pins the first model the runner tries. opencode executor is fully instrumented (tokens/session audited via oc.sh); kilo/hermes are best-effort token logging.
_parallel_example: The two independent scaffold tasks below are designed to run together: backend via opencode, frontend via kilo, each on a different model.

tasks.prompt: CREATE backend/ in this project. Scaffold Node.js Express + TypeScript REST API + Prisma. Files: backend/package.json (express,cors,dotenv,jsonwebtoken,bcryptjs + dev typescript/tsx/@types/*), backend/tsconfig.json (strict,NodeNext), backend/.env.example, backend/prisma/schema.prisma (User{id,email,passwordHash,createdAt}, Task{...}), backend/src/lib/config.ts, backend/src/lib/prisma.ts. Do NOT create auth routes or app wiring. Verify: ls backend/ contains the listed files.

CREATE frontend/ in this project. Scaffold React + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind + Zustand + react-router-dom. Files: frontend/package.json, frontend/tsconfig.json, frontend/vite.config.ts, frontend/tailwind.config.js, frontend/postcss.config.js, frontend/index.html, frontend/src/main.tsx. Do NOT touch backend/. Verify: ls frontend/ contains package.json, vite.config.ts, index.html, src/main.tsx.

CREATE backend/src/modules/auth/ + backend/src/middleware/auth.ts. Files: auth.ts(Bearer JWT verify, attach req.userId, 401), routes.ts(/register /login /me), register.ts(bcrypt+JWT, 409 dup), login.ts(verify+sign tokens), me.ts(return user minus hash). Use lib/config.ts + lib/prisma.ts already present. Do NOT edit index.ts or docker. Verify: npx tsc --noEmit passes in backend/.

CREATE backend/src/index.ts + backend/src/routes/index.ts. Wire Express app: cors, json, mount /api/auth and /api/tasks, listen PORT. routes: GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/tasks protected by middleware. Use existing lib/config.ts, lib/prisma.ts. Do NOT touch modules/auth/*. Verify: npx tsc --noEmit in backend/.
CREATE frontend/src/lib/types.ts, api.ts, authStore.ts, Login.tsx, Register.tsx, ProtectedRoute.tsx. Uses existing frontend/ scaffolding. Verify: imports match existing store/types API.
CREATE frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx, components, App.tsx, main.tsx, index.css. React router app: /login /register / (ProtectedRoute>Dashboard). Verify: imports match existing types/api store.
